title: Architecture
subject: Architecture
summary: Study the design of buildings and places, and take the first step towards becoming an architect.
description: You develop design, drawing and model-making skills in studio projects, alongside history, theory and technology.
This degree is usually the first stage (Part 1) of training to become a registered architect.
entryRequirements: A-levels, BTEC or an Access to Higher Education Diploma (Level 3)
GCSE English and Maths at grade 4/C or above
